fact: The Electronic Government Act (Commencement) Order, 2022 (SI 1 of 2022), published in the Government Gazette on 7 January 2022, brought the Electronic Government Act, 2021 into force on 5 January 2022.
title: Electronic Government Act (Commencement) Order, 2022
publisher: Government of Zambia (Statutory Instrument 1 of 2022, via ZambiaLII)
